name: Local Imitation Evaluation v1
description: Measure whether Lyme Model imitates useful teacher behavior

criteria.same_relevant_files: Model reads same files as teacher would
criteria.tool_sequence_length: Model uses similar number of tool calls (±2)
criteria.patch_minimality: Model's patch is no more than 2 lines larger than teacher's
criteria.test_success: Model's fix passes the same tests
criteria.hallucination: Model does not reference files the teacher didn't need
